beforeNotes: The first clean run proves four WS/Stock failures; the corrected Student setup proves both Student failures. An earlier setup leaked its test server; only its exact runner/PID and descendants were stopped, then setup cleanup was fixed.

resolvedBroadFailure.name: Stock quantities survive same-subject clicks and cancelled level changes (browser)
resolvedBroadFailure.resolution: Wait for the prior native dialog close event before the next selection; all original value/quantity assertions retained.

startupFix.cause: A rejected startup info query was incorrectly treated as a successful legacy-host response.
startupFix.fix: Unknown info failures keep protection and retry after load/focus; only valid legacy-host metadata disables native prevention.
resolvedCases: Desktop close defaults to staying and closes only after an explicit discard
Unsaved student-manager survives cancelled navigation and allows deliberate leave (desktop)

deduplication: 352 service/HTTP checks plus 106 exact-name unique UI checks: 84 regression cases and 22 leave cases. Guard/stock, host compatibility and startup rechecks do not add repeat counts.
